# JIKKO Japanese Knives

> A heritage Japanese cutlery brand from Sakai since 1901, specializing in hand-forged kitchen knives with traditional craftsmanship and the proprietary Hatsuke sharpening method.

JIKKO offers a curated selection of professional-grade Japanese kitchen knives across multiple series, from premium honyaki blades to rust-resistant stainless steel options. The brand combines centuries of Sakai craftsmanship with modern steel technologies including carbon steel, SG2, VG10, and Damascus patterns.

## Knife Collections

- [[Shiko] Kitchen Knives Series](https://jikkocutlery.com/collections/shiko): Shiko Series professional kitchen knives hand-forged in Sakai
- [[Gion] Kitchen Knives Series](https://jikkocutlery.com/collections/gion): Gion Series professional single-bevel kitchen knives from Sakai
- [[Ginza] Kitchen Knives Series](https://jikkocutlery.com/collections/ginza): Ginza Series professional hand-forged kitchen knives with carbon steel
- [[Honyaki Mt.fuji] Kitchen Knives Series](https://jikkocutlery.com/collections/honyaki-mt-fuji): Premium Honyaki Mt.Fuji Series with mirror-polished blades
- [[Honyaki Namiukashi] Kitchen Knives Series](https://jikkocutlery.com/collections/namiukashi): Honyaki Namiukashi Series white carbon steel premium cutlery
- [[Toshin] Kitchen Knives Series](https://jikkocutlery.com/collections/toushin): Toshin Series mirror-polished honyaki knives with Ginsan steel
- [[JIKKO SS] Kitchen Knives Series](https://jikkocutlery.com/collections/jikko-shop): JIKKO SS Series with SG2 stainless steel and Damascus patterns
- [[Loco & Boco] Kitchen Knives Series](https://jikkocutlery.com/collections/loco-boco): Loco & Boco Damascus Series with SG2 and VG10 stainless steel
- [[Never Stain] Kitchen Knives Series](https://jikkocutlery.com/collections/never-stain): Never Stain Series rust-resistant SG2 powder steel kitchen knives
- [[Hiho] Kitchen Knives Series](https://jikkocutlery.com/collections/hiho): Hiho Series VG10 Damascus stainless-carbon kitchen knives
- [[JIKKO shiki] Kitchen Knives Series](https://jikkocutlery.com/collections/jikko-shiki): JIKKO shiki Series with Super Blue carbon steel chef and utility knives
